$comment: Shared contract stub. Structure only, no gameplay numbers. All packages import this; maintainer-owned. D18: claims added as a structured-evidence channel; field set locked by digest.

settlement_manifest.digest_rule: sha256 of (sorted(required)+sorted(optional)) joined by comma; D18 constraint 3: any field-set change must update this digest via maintainer review
settlement_manifest.note: Field set must not be extended by any package (invariant I4). claims is a JSON-encoded string carrying structured evidence; engine decodes it, never reads concrete axis names.

claims_schema.$comment: D18: claims must be structured evidence, never a bare score/grade/credits number. Encoded as a JSON string so the frozen field set and X02 type probes stay stable.
claims_schema.note: score/volume are EVIDENCE for the engine to recompute a rating, not a payout. The engine must never copy score directly into credits.

double_report_rule.$comment: D18 constraint 1: credit_delta stays required by the frozen field set, so a claims-based manifest carries credit_delta=0. Any non-zero credit_delta alongside claims is a second payout authority and is rejected unconditionally (even before the chain is enabled) so the loophole is probeable today.
double_report_rule.rule: reject claims + non-zero credit_delta with rejected_double_report
